name: Bandersnatch
desc: A product of bio-alchemy, once flourished in Snezhnaya. Back then, the elements of all life were countless puzzle pieces scattered across the ground, and the researchers who experimented with them pieced them together as they pleased. Most of their creations, however, violated the laws of the world and perished in failure. Lurking in the dark, fixing its vacant gaze upon its prey as it moves through rock, earth, ice, and snow, this monster may be the most cunning of those that still remain in the world today.
